title: Forum threads
description: Complete upstream forum-dl corpus in bundled Python: Discourse, Hacker News, Hyperkitty, Hypermail, Invision, phpBB, Pipermail, ProBoards, Simple Machines, vBulletin and XenForo. Browser HTTP credentials and original responses are shared with the recorder.

FORUMDL_MAX_REQUESTS.description: Request budget; exhausting it marks the capture incomplete.

FORUMDL_MAX_MB.description: Original response byte budget including attachments.

FORUMDL_FILES.description: Fetch all files emitted by upstream, including assets outside posts.

FORUMDL_HTTP_TIMEOUT.description: Per-request browser transport timeout in seconds.
